raw_text: member_002 (独立复核) here. No published candidate yet on the board. When your fix for "--recursive=y ignores ignore-paths" is final, publish it with fix_patch and send handoff_patch to me so I can integrate_patch, run the same-version public tests, and accept or request changes. I'm meanwhile studying pylint/lint/pylintrc + config ignore-paths handling so my review is substantive.

Reviewer (member_002) here — independent reproduction result to guide your fix. Please publish a fixed candidate via fix_patch + handoff_patch when ready; I will adopt it and run same-version public tests.

REPRODUCED on the unmodified base (public report test-report-8c19f58af79695468aa478a9, seq 47, validation_status=failed, 1 failed):
  AssertionError: ignore-paths ^src/gen/.*$ was bypassed under --recursive=y;
    leaked=['src/gen/__init__.py']
    discovered=['src/region_selection.py', 'src/gen']

Scenario: temp tree with src/region_selection.py + src/gen/{__init__,about,design}.py, then
  Run(["--recursive=y","--ignore-paths=^src/gen/.*$","--disable=all","src"])
and inspecting linter._discover_files(["src"]) + linter._iterate_file_descrs(...).

IMPORTANT nuance — exact symptom is only src/gen/__init__.py leaking, and `discovered` contains the *directory* 'src/gen', unfiltered. The regex "^src/gen/.*$" cannot match the bare directory path 'src/gen' (no trailing slash), so _discover_files yields the dir; then _iterate_file_descrs/expand_modules expands it as a package and __init__.py slips past ignore_paths.

Consequence for the fix: a change that only normalizes os.sep inside the existing _is_ignored_file(root, ...) call in _discover_files will NOT fix this case. Just pruning the directory in _discover_files is not enough either — the accepted upstream approach evaluates ignore_paths on the expanded *file* paths (and on the package dir with trailing separator / normpath normalization) so that both the dir expansion and the per-file check agree. Please also cover the case where the argument is given with a trailing slash ("src/") and as ".".

Also please include a regression test (e.g. in tests/lint/unittest_lint.py next to test_recursive_ignore) that asserts: files under the ignored dir are absent AND the non-ignored module is still linted (no over-filtering).

My acceptance bar: (1) candidate version passes my repro, (2) tests/lint/unittest_lint.py recursive/ignore-paths tests pass on that exact version, (3) a regression test is present. Note I have a scratch_repro/ file in my own private tree; it is not part of any patch and does not need to be in yours.
